description:
The Property Company is pleased to present this stunning ground-floor maisonette, recently refurbished. The property features two spacious bedrooms, a bright reception room, a modern separate kitchen, a beautifully finished bathroom, and a private garden—ideal for outdoor relaxation.

While the garden offers great privacy, it backs onto the beautiful Alexandra Park and Palace, with a convenient entrance just 100 yards away, allowing easy access to the park's open spaces.

Nestled on a quiet street, this home is perfectly located near Muswell Hill, Crouch End, and Hornsey, giving you easy access to a range of amenities, including shops, restaurants, and well-regarded local schools. The area also benefits from excellent transport links, with National Rail services providing quick and convenient access to the city.
keyFeatures: Separate kitchen and a beautifully finished bathroom
Located on a quiet street near Muswell Hill, Crouch End, and Hornsey
Close to various amenities, including shops, restaurants, and local schools
Excellent transport links via National Rail, offering easy access to the city
